### Environment
```{r setup}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,  
  eval = TRUE, 
  tidy = TRUE
)

knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = "../"
)


# Environment Set up
rm(list = ls()) #Clean workspace
cat("\014")     #Clean Console
gc() # Free memory

# pipeline variables
long.compute <- TRUE
do.plot <- TRUE

# Establish working directory
library("rstudioapi")

# Set working directory to source file location
setwd(dirname(getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
setwd("..")

# Create output directories & load custom functions & colour scheme
source("scripts/Setup.R", local = knitr::knit_global())



# load packages
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratData)
library(dplyr)

```



## Loading and formatting dataset {.tabset}

### load dataset
```{r load_dataset}

# load dataset
kaede.seurat <- LoadH5Seurat("saves/kaede_imputed.h5Seurat")

kaede.seurat # 16,665 genes across 12,843 cells

DefaultAssay(kaede.seurat) <- "originalexp"
```

### Clean and filter dataset for just NK cells at 48hours

```{r filter_dataset}

# clean dataset, keep only 48 hour timepoint as this is by far the timepoint with majority of the cells both red and green 

table(kaede.seurat@meta.data$celltype_cluster_paper, kaede.seurat@meta.data$time)


##############################
# keep only 48 hour timepoint
##############################
Idents(kaede.seurat) <- kaede.seurat@meta.data$time
unique(Idents(kaede.seurat))


kaede.seurat.NK <- subset(kaede.seurat, idents = c("Green_48h", "Red_48h"))


##############################
# remove ILC1 and NKT populations 
##############################
Idents(kaede.seurat.NK) <- kaede.seurat.NK@meta.data$celltype_cluster_paper
unique(Idents(kaede.seurat.NK))


kaede.seurat.NK <- subset(kaede.seurat.NK, idents = c("ILC", "NKT"), invert = TRUE)

# clean environment
rm(kaede.seurat)
gc()
```

### Metabolic genes
```{r metabolic_genes_overview}

# create output dir
output.dir <- paste0("results/metabolic_genes/")

if(!dir.exists(output.dir)){
  dir.create(output.dir, 
             recursive = T)
  
}


# list of human metabolic genes of interest provided by susanna to investigate
metabolic.genes <- readxl::read_excel("data/List of metabolic molecules to interrogate in RNA-seq data.xlsx")
metabolic.genes <- metabolic.genes$`Gene name`

# convert to mouse genes
metabolic.genes.mouse <- usefulfunctions::convert.human.to.mouse(metabolic.genes, use.jax = TRUE)
length(metabolic.genes.mouse) # 49
length(metabolic.genes) # 51


for(i in seq_along(metabolic.genes.mouse)){
  
  if(metabolic.genes.mouse[i] %in% rownames(kaede.seurat.NK)){
    print(
      scCustomize::VlnPlot_scCustom(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                                    features = metabolic.genes.mouse[i],
                                    pt.size = 0.1,
                                    group.by = "time")
    )
    dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "VlnPlot_", metabolic.genes.mouse[i], ".pdf"))
    dev.off()
    
  }
}




DefaultAssay(kaede.seurat.NK) <- "originalexp"

# create pseudobulk for visualisation
pseudo.NK <- AggregateExpression(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                                 assays = "originalexp",
                                 return.seurat = TRUE,
                                 group.by = c("celltype_cluster_paper", "time"))


DoHeatmap(pseudo.NK, 
          features = metabolic.genes.mouse, 
          draw.lines = FALSE, 
          raster = FALSE)

dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "Heatmap_pseudobulk_cluster_time_metabolic_genes.pdf"))
dev.off()





pseudo.NK <- AggregateExpression(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                                 assays = "originalexp",
                                 return.seurat = TRUE,
                                 group.by = c("time"))


DoHeatmap(pseudo.NK, 
          features = metabolic.genes.mouse, 
          draw.lines = FALSE, 
          raster = FALSE)

dev.copy(pdf, paste0(output.dir, "Heatmap_pseudobulk_time_metabolic_genes.pdf"))
dev.off()

```


### DEG analysis
```{r DEG_analyis}
Idents(kaede.seurat.NK) <- kaede.seurat.NK@meta.data$time
unique(Idents(kaede.seurat.NK))

DefaultAssay(kaede.seurat.NK) <- "originalexp"


early.markers <- FindMarkers(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                             ident.1 = "Green_48h", 
                             ident.2 = "Red_48h",
                             min.pct = 0.1)

goi <- early.markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::top_n(50, avg_log2FC) %>%
  rownames()

early.markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))
goi


scCustomize::Stacked_VlnPlot(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                             features = goi,
                             pt.size = 0,
                             group.by = "time")




# gene signature 
cd160.sig <- read.csv("data/CD160_DEG_QLF_S.PosvsNeg.csv")

pos.sig <- cd160.sig %>%
  dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::top_n(50, logFC) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(genes)

pos.sig



kaede.seurat.NK <- AddModuleScore(kaede.seurat.NK,
                                  features = list(cd160sig = pos.sig), 
                                  name = "CD160_sig")


head(kaede.seurat@meta.data)
VlnPlot_scCustom(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                 features = "CD160_sig1", 
                 group.by = "celltype_cluster_paper")


VlnPlot_scCustom(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                 features = "CD160_sig1", 
                 group.by = "time")




VlnPlot_scCustom(kaede.seurat.NK, 
                 features = "Acat2", 
                 group.by = "time")


RidgePlot(kaede.seurat.NK, 
          features = "CD160_sig1", 
          group.by = "time")


# IFN-signalling signature 
kaede.seurat.NK




```

### Cytotoxic molecule expression
```{r cytotoxic_molecules}


output.dir <- paste0("results/cytotoxic_molecules/")

if(!dir.exists(output.dir)){
  dir.create(output.dir, 
             recursive = T)
  
}




table(kaede.seurat@meta.data$celltype_cluster_paper, kaede.seurat@meta.data$time)



##############################
# remove ILC1 and NKT populations 
##############################
Idents(kaede.seurat) <- kaede.seurat@meta.data$celltype_cluster_paper
unique(Idents(kaede.seurat))


temp.seurat <- subset(kaede.seurat, idents = c("ILC", "NKT"), invert = TRUE)






goi <- early.markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  rownames()

logic.vec <- cytotoxicity.markers %in% goi
cytotoxicity.markers[logic.vec]

early.markers %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
tibble::rownames_to_column() %>%
  dplyr::filter(rowname %in% cytotoxicity.markers)

cytotoxicity.markers <- c("Gzma", "Gzmb", "Gzmh", "Gzmk", "Gzmm", "Gnly", "Prf1", "Nkg7")

scCustomize::Stacked_VlnPlot(temp.seurat, 
                              features = cytotoxicity.markers,
                              pt.size = 0,
                              group.by = "time")


Idents(temp.seurat) <- temp.seurat@meta.data$time
average.seurat <- AverageExpression(temp.seurat, features = cytotoxicity.markers, return.seurat = T)

DoHeatmap(average.seurat, cytotoxicity.markers, draw.lines = F)

scCustomize::VlnPlot_scCustom(kaede.seurat.NK,
```
